$comment: Keiko Editor bundle-size budget (Issue #1207; ADR-0042 D3.6). Enforced deterministically by scripts/editor-bundle-size.mjs, which runs standalone (`npm run check:editor-bundle-size`) and inside `check:package-surface` (the `ci` prepack chain). PR CI for feat/keiko-editor also runs it after `npm run build:ui` with `--require-static-export` so initial static-export JS is scanned. The 2.5 MB-gzip lazy editor + Monaco runtime budget and the <=750 KB-gzip per-worker-chunk budget are measured against the real production bundle as release evidence by #1209; this file enforces the parts that regress in this repo deterministically: the editor package's own compiled footprint, the pinned Monaco version the runtime footprint was measured against, and the first-load code-split isolation (Monaco/editor runtime value-imported only behind a client-only dynamic boundary). The editor own-code ceiling is rebased from 96 KiB to 100 KiB for the current Monaco 0.55.1 multi-language editor dist (100629 B across 71 files after a clean @oscharko-dev/keiko-editor build), preserving ~1.7 KiB margin while still catching accidental heavy dependency or Monaco bundling. The 320 KiB initial-page ceiling records the rebased #2055 + #1982 desktop baseline, rebased for Epic #2238 (governed Atlassian connector UI), rebased again (315392 -> 323584, +8 KiB) for the PR #2315 i18n retrofit of six previously-uncovered Quality/Files widgets (AgentRunWidget, FilePreview, FilesWidget, PdfCitationPreviewWindow, ReviewWidget, FigmaSnapshotWindow), rebased again (323584 -> 327680, +4 KiB) for the PR #2306 SonarCloud S3776 cleanup on top of that i18n retrofit, and rebased again (327680 -> 331776, +4 KiB) for PR #2471's merge of dev's #2469 Coding Workbench governance feature (CodingWorkbenchQuestions/Sections/Window plus its own eagerly-loaded EN/DE i18n catalogs, all first-load desktop-shell surface) on top of #2471's own SonarCloud RELIABILITY remediation (a handful of terser regex one-liners in AppShell.tsx replaced with slightly larger, S8786-safe manual-scan helpers). CI/Linux measured 327686 B at the merged HEAD, confirmed in an isolated Linux container build (not just CI); the new ceiling keeps the same ~4 KiB margin as the prior rebase. CI/Linux remains the authoritative static-export measurement. See docs/keiko-editor/1207-performance-budgets.md. Rebased again (331776 -> 335872, +4 KiB) for the Epic #2473 Wave-1 Coding Workbench surface merged by PR #2602: the safe-activity timeline with multi-segment messages and plan cards (#2479/#2480/#2481), the run-scoped changes panel (#2482), the governed research grant chip and its pre-approval destination panel (#2387), and the EN/DE catalog entries all of these add — every one first-load desktop-shell surface. Issue #2639 then landed the eager-CodingWorkbench-import split (335872 -> 333824, -2 KiB), moving the three provider profile fetchers to a dynamic subtree. On top of the merged dev baseline (ceiling 333824), the Epic #2285 M11 branch (this PR) adds +9 KiB rebase to 340992 for the multi-root workspaces, workspace-trust hooks and API clients, trust badge, profiles, local history and the eagerly-catalogued EN/DE messages for the new trust, profile, history and multi-root Explorer surfaces. Prior isolated-container measurement (before the dev merge): dev@5fee8d1b first-load 330995 B, M11 branch 336740 B (+5745 B; SearchPanel keys already moved to the lazy widget catalog for -827 B, remaining M11 catalog migration estimated at ~1.8 KiB and tracked as follow-up). Rebase ceiling of 340992 preserves the ~4 KiB margin against the isolated-container M11 measurement; the real ceiling after the merge is CI/Linux authoritative and is tightened by a deliberate local regeneration in the D12 reference environment (ADR-0156 D6) if the actual first-load lands lower than expected.
$comment_firstLoadRuntimeValueImporters: checkFirstLoadIsolation is a flat value-import scan over packages/keiko-ui/src; it cannot follow a next/dynamic(ssr:false) boundary, so a module that is only ever reached through one still reports as a first-load importer. Each entry below is allow-listed because its sole importer resolves it dynamically with ssr:false, which is what actually keeps the editor runtime out of the first-load chunk. Epic #2285 (M11) added the last two: MultiRootEditorHost.tsx is imported only by SelectionAwareWorkspaceHosts.tsx, which widgets/index.tsx loads through dynamic(..., { ssr: false }) for the Chat/Files/Editor window hosts; EditorFileHistoryPanel.tsx is loaded only by EditorRuntimeWidget.tsx via dynamic(() => import('./EditorFileHistoryPanel'), { ssr: false }). The authoritative first-load proof is not this scan but initialPageChunkGzipBytesCeiling, measured against a real static export on CI/Linux with --require-static-export; if either module ever leaks into the initial chunk, that ceiling fails regardless of this allow-list. Issue #2621 swapped MultiRootEditorHost.tsx for SelectionAwareWorkspaceHosts.tsx one-for-one: the removed-root model disposal had to move up to EditorWindowSessionHost, because dropping a two-root workspace to a single root unmounts MultiRootEditorHost on exactly the transition the disposal must react to. The justification is unchanged and in fact shorter — SelectionAwareWorkspaceHosts.tsx IS the module widgets/index.tsx loads through dynamic(..., { ssr: false }), rather than a module one hop behind it — and MultiRootEditorHost.tsx no longer value-imports the runtime at all, so leaving it listed would trip this file's own stale-entry check. The allow-list neither grew nor changed shape; the local static export measured 0 Monaco markers across 14 first-load scripts after the swap.
